display_name: AufenthV § 26 and Anlage C, the airport transit visa: a law layer, a seat for the person changing planes, and the Art. 80(1) sentence 3 citation test
seat: a person changing planes at a German airport, asking whether they must hold an airport transit visa and whether they are exempt from needing a residence title while they wait in the international transit area.
edition: AufenthV § 26 and Anlage C, AufenthG § 99, Grundgesetz Art. 80, as printed on gesetze-im-internet.de on 2026-11-02 (../../registers/source-bundle/); BVerfG 2 BvF 3/90 paras. 151 to 158; the 2015 amending regulation's preamble only as the article quotes it (an aid).
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the text. The texts are the site's reading versions, not the gazette. The preamble of the 2015 amending regulation, and the statement that it added Mali and South Sudan, rest on a quotation in the article and have not been checked against the Federal Law Gazette. The tests' expected values were written by the encoder from the text, not by an independent author.

scope.intent: AufenthV § 26 and Anlage C; AufenthG § 99(3a) as the power needed; Grundgesetz Art. 80(1) sentence 3 as the citation test. Not the rest of the Residence Regulation, the rest of § 99, or the Visa Code.
